description: Partner pack for Tether (USDT) — largest stablecoin by circulating supply, available on 15+ chains. Biases toward cross-chain payment rails, emerging-market remittance, and USDT-denominated trading surfaces.

defaults.headline: Build on USDT — cross-chain stablecoin rails
defaults.subheadline: USDT is live on Ethereum, Tron, Solana, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Polygon, BSC + more. Tune flows for remittance, merchant payments, and dollar-denominated trading.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions USDT, Tether, stablecoin payments, remittance, or dollar-denominated on-chain commerce.
firstSteps: Pick the chain first, THEN the USDT contract address. Contract addresses in partner-config.json.contracts map by chain — there is no canonical USDT contract across chains.
For frontend flows, show the chain name alongside the USDT balance — users regularly confuse Tron USDT with Ethereum USDT.
For merchant/remittance flows, prefer Tron or Arbitrum for sub-cent gas; default to Ethereum only when institutional flows require it.
gotchas: USDT on Ethereum is NOT a standard ERC-20 — it's missing the bool return on `approve` and `transferFrom`. Use SafeERC20 or viem's `writeContract` which handles this.
USDT on Tron uses TRC-20 — a completely different chain. Don't assume an Ethereum wallet can send Tron USDT.
USDT issuance/redemption is permissioned at the Tether-Ltd level. Addresses can be blacklisted — design escrow + treasury flows to handle this.
